sql_calls.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_units_daily_sales,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_units_pos_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status='on shelf' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_on_shelf_audits,
  (SELECT MIN(audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS first_audit,
  (SELECT MAX(audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS last_audit;

SELECT audit_ts, sku, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, d.revenue_inr, i.book_on_hand_close,
       f.forecast_units_per_day, f.book_on_hand AS forecast_book_on_hand, f.ordered_units
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date=d.date AND i.sku=d.sku
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date=d.date AND f.sku=d.sku
WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT 'stock_counts' AS source, count_ts::text AS ts, trigger AS detail, book_before::text AS before_value, counted::text AS counted_value, adjustment::text AS adjustment_value
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', audit_ts::text, status, NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY ts;

SELECT sku,
       COUNT(*) AS audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf') AS on_shelf,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='empty') AS empty,
       MIN(audit_ts) AS first_audit,
       MAX(audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY sku;
